name: Boku no Watashi
source:
Kirito, a high school student, is asked by his senior to work part-time at a convenience store for a week.
At his work, Kirito meets a beautiful person. Over the course of the week, Kirito finds himself increasingly drawn to this person.

[Translated from the [url=https://sakuramint01.kagennotuki.com/bmg/bmg_index.html]official website[/url]]
